author: Dan; implemented by Codex
hypothesis: Cost-aware replacement improves completed paired grids per hour while retaining positive total net returns.
ranking: min(crossings_4h/4, crossings_24h/24); historical crossing proxy, not a forecast guarantee
selection: For each holdout select N and margin on its preceding seven days only, maximizing completed grids/hour; ties use net then smaller N then margin. Freeze parameters throughout the holdout.
execution_assumptions: Only candidate replacement or range exit is a discretionary stop; forced liquidation and data unavailability are explicit exceptions.
Neutral startup gross 50 percent split between long and short is an explicit unverified paper allocation rule.
Replay each candle using both OHLC paths and retain the lower ending-equity path; this is a sensitivity model, not observed fills.
Missing historical spread, depth, listing or eight-hour funding evidence invalidates eligibility; never use future snapshots or assume zero funding.
End-of-window positions are marked and a market-close cost reserve is reported without a strategy stop.
A seeded random eligible-coin null uses identical fill, sizing, replacement and cost rules.
